# Voice of America (VOA)

> Voice of America delivers independent international news and information in multiple languages, covering U.S. foreign policy, global affairs, and regional developments across the world.

VOA operates as a U.S. government-funded multimedia news organization providing news services in dozens of languages, including English, Bosnian, and Amharic. The site covers breaking news on world politics, conflicts in regions like Ukraine, Syria, and Iraq, and features analysis of key global actors including Russia, the Kremlin, and U.S. leadership.

## Key Topics

- Voice of America (VOA)
- International news and breaking news
- U.S. foreign policy and global affairs
- Trump and U.S. Senate politics
- Russia, Putin, and the Kremlin
- Ukraine conflict
- Syria and ISIS
- Middle East (Iraq, Abu Khadija)
- Regional news (Balkans, South Africa, Uzbekistan)
- Multilingual broadcasting
- Studio Washington programs
- Radio and TV multimedia content
- World politics and diplomacy
- Starmer and international leaders

## Main English News

- [VOA - Voice of America English News](https://www.voanews.com): VOA homepage: breaking news on US, Russia, Senate, and world politics

## Regional Language Services

- [Glas Amerike | Bosna i Hercegovina - Vijesti, analize, multimedija](https://ba.voanews.com/): VOA Bosnian service for Bosnia & Herzegovina with Studio Washington content
- [Amharic News 1800 - Articles - የአሜሪካ ድምፅ](https://amharic.voanews.com/one-hour-radio-show/articles): VOA Amharic one-hour radio show articles and news coverage
